Dear Bothrs team,

I'm applying for the UX/UI Designer role in the Healthblocks team. Your mission to democratize digital healthcare through a low-code SaaS platform resonates deeply with me, especially given my background in healthcare tech and my passion for design systems.

As a digital marketer with a technical edge, I've spent years building and optimizing websites, often taking on design responsibilities. I've designed and built sites from scratch, maintained component-based layouts, and ensured they meet user needs and business goals. My experience with WordPress, Elementor, and custom front-end work has taught me to balance aesthetics with functionality and scalability.

I'm fluent in English, comfortable with Figma and other design tools, and have a strong interest in healthcare. I thrive in iterative environments, using feedback to refine designs and validate concepts. I'm excited about the opportunity to shape Healthblocks' design system and collaborate with your product and engineering teams.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Bothrs team,

I'm writing to apply for the UX/UI Designer position within the Healthblocks team. Your mission to democratize digital healthcare by providing a low-code SaaS platform for building health products is both innovative and impactful. As someone with a background in healthcare technology and a strong interest in design systems, I'm excited about the opportunity to contribute to this vision.

My career has been centered around digital marketing and web development, where I've consistently taken on design responsibilities. I've designed and built websites from the ground up, ensuring they are user-friendly, visually appealing, and aligned with business objectives. For instance, I designed and developed baverok.com using WordPress and Elementor, incorporating a hand-coded landing page with a WebGL hero and accessible markup. I also built and optimized mirook.com, implementing structured data and running iterative audits to improve search health. These projects required me to think like a UX/UI designer—considering user flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity prototypes—even if my title didn't reflect it.

I'm fluent in English and comfortable with Figma, having used it for design explorations and prototyping. I've worked with design systems that engineering teams actively use, ensuring consistency and scalability. My experience with lean thinking and iterative design has taught me to validate concepts quickly, gather user feedback, and prioritize features that deliver value. I'm also passionate about healthcare, having worked on a healthcare web application at ViviDoctor, where I developed front-end features and optimized the user experience.

As the first UX/UI Designer at Healthblocks, I would lead the product design process by exploring design concepts through sketches, user flows, and wireframes, and then building high-fidelity prototypes. I'm comfortable validating prototypes with clients in design sprints and collaborating closely with product managers and engineers to execute all visual design stages. I understand the importance of maintaining a flexible, scalable design system and language, and I'm eager to chase opportunities to keep it pragmatic and component-based.

I bring a lean-thinking, user-oriented approach, and I'm not afraid to challenge design briefings to dig deeper into user needs. Feedback drives progress, and I'm committed to providing radical yet constructive feedback to ensure the best outcomes. I'm motivated to stay in touch with design leaders and bring inspiration to the team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my skills and passion can contribute to Healthblocks' success.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Designed and built baverok.com and mirook.com from scratch, including hand-coded landing pages, structured data, and accessible markup, demonstrating end-to-end UX/UI skills.
• Experience with design systems: maintained consistent layouts for ~600 member profile pages and built component-based WordPress sites used by engineering teams.
• Proficient in Figma for design explorations and prototyping, with a strong interest in healthcare and prior front-end development for a healthcare web application.
• Fluent in English and experienced in lean thinking, iterative design, and validating prototypes with user feedback.
• Comfortable collaborating with product managers and engineers, and passionate about maintaining scalable, pragmatic design systems.
